profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Developer
profile.summary: Full-stack software developer accustomed to the fast-paced requirements of the startup world, but always works hard to maintain strong core coding foundations in order to build the best systems possible.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Test Engineer
positions.description:
Developed multiple C#/.NET/WPF/Python libraries used for rapid development of complete applications in testing hardware with custom test fixtures and/or self-contained testing APIs, allowing manufacturing operators to have one-touch solutions in testing hardware.

Worked directly with clients to develop automated testing solutions for multiple products with data collection, analysis, and presentation used in creating test specifications and solving manufacturing issues.
 
Developed a platform application for integrating any custom or off-the-shelf testing hardware with the in-house shop floor API to keep track of testing logs in order to automate management of manufactured products, collect test data, and prevent untested products from shipment.
	
Used feedback from manufacturing operators to continuously improve test applications, streamlining manufacturing tests and improving product output time.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Back-End Web Development · C# · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · .NET Framework

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Back-End Web Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · iOS · Django

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed an infrastructure of iOS libraries (consistent design elements, low-level BLE interface, server connection) and cloud implementations (Python/Django, Amazon AWS) that could meet the needs of an expanding smart apparel platform leading to the creation of 4 full iOS apps (basketball shooting sleeve, physical therapy knee brace, two MLB skills) in as little as 2 weeks each.

Personally worked on-site with coaches who needed to use and integrate the new motion capture data into their existing processes to adapt our real-time feedback systems and generated reports into a more familiar form that helped the coaches digest and use the data for their players’ development. 

Wrote the first version of the basketball shooting app, providing real-time feedback, analysis, and gamification for a consumer facing, sleeve-only, version of the motion capture wearable, laying the foundations for expanding the platform into other sports and applications.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Wrote a Unity and Java app to run sensor fusion algorithms and visualize real-time motion capture data using a 3D human model for an experimental full body suit of embedded sensors transmitting data over Wi-Fi.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
3D Graphics Lab under Associate professor James Davis. 

Created demos and experiments for comparing simultaneous 3D and 2D displays using different hardware combinations for running user preference testing on the different methods used for Scher, S., Liu, J., Vaish, R., Gunawardane, P., Davis, J. (SIGGRAPH 2013). 3D+ 2DTV: 3D displays with no ghosting for viewers without glasses.

projects.title: One Day
projects.description:
Senior Game Design Capstone Project

Experimental 2D game for Unity, using C# and Javasript, exploring how to incite introspection in players through sandbox exploration with the ability to switch between three ages of the main characters, seeing the consequences of actions as they occur. 
Team of nine developers, five artists, and one musician. 
Used Scrum and Github to manage the project

Role: Acted as liaison between the art team and design team. Handled age switching mechanic and managing various components. Gameplay programming. UI/UX Programming.

projects.title: eBay Mantis Video
projects.description:
Senior Computer Science Capstone Project

Developed an Android application to capture and record video data for eBay Research Labs to be used in providing better user experience when listening auctions.
Team of five developers. 
Used GitHub and Scrum to manage the project. Also used Django and Heroku for server deployment and Amazon S3 for data storage to manage the data.

Role: Handled user authentication, client-side interactions with the server, and maintained/refactored code across all developers.
